A ticket to a new life

Jim was an ordinary student living in a rented flat in New York. During the holidays, he visited his rich uncle Arthur, who lived in a magnificent country mansion. This beautiful house, with its huge garden and expensive furniture, always made Jim feel like an outsider. Arthur was a harmful man and never missed an opportunity to make rude remarks about his nephew at dinner.

After a serious argument, Jim decided to leave early. While waiting for a taxi in the hall, he accidentally dropped his bag, and a letter fell out of his uncle's coat. Picking it up, Jim caught a glimpse of a familiar name.

It was a letter from a lawyer. It stated that due to financial issues, uncle Arthur was completely bankrupt. The mansion and all his savings were being auctioned off to pay his debts. Moreover, the letter mentioned that his uncle was planning to borrow money from Jim to hide the truth from his mates.

Jim froze. The twist was that nobody could have expected this: the rich man was actually a beggar. Jim realized he no longer had to put up with the humiliation, and he felt very relieved. He didn't want to stay in this house a minute . Jim happened to see the letter and decided to book a ticket for the first train heading home.
